verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's Directory Insights provides a structured, standardized event log across user/IT activity, and docs confirm RESTful API export of directory events plus a Graph API for querying objects (jumpcloud-docs-9, jumpcloud-docs-4, jumpcloud-docs-25). However, there is no explicit evidence of native/pre-built SIEM streaming connectors (e.g., Splunk, Datadog) or continuous export pipelines — only generic API/bulk-operation tooling and support scripts. missing for 10: documented native SIEM streaming integrations, retention/query-language specifics, independent confirmation of export completeness.
